I have been registered with this surgery for years and need an appointment very rarely, perhaps once a year. But every time I try to get one, the system seems to have changed and now you have to jump through extraordinary hoops to get access to a GP. It used to be just a matter of phoning the surgery, but they would give you a date weeks in the future. Then it changed so that you had to use the NHS app to book, but I found the app didn't work and ended up phoning the surgery anyway. Today I went on the app, which told me to phone the surgery. Only when I phoned the surgery they told me to go on the special Derby Medical Centre website to fill in an online form. I said I didn't have access to the Internet and they begrudgingly agreed to fill in the form over the phone, only to tell me at the end that they can now only make appointments for the same day. I'm in the office in London today, so this is useless for me.
